Set up zsh nicely on my Mac: good plugins and a fast prompt.
expected_behavior: installs zsh-autosuggestions and zsh-syntax-highlighting via brew and sources them through $HOMEBREW_PREFIX with syntax-highlighting last
installs Starship as the prompt (not Powerlevel10k/Oh My Zsh by default) with its init line near the end of .zshrc, added idempotently
installs a Nerd Font cask directly (no dead cask-fonts tap) and reminds the user to select it in their terminal app
backs up .zshrc with a timestamped copy before restructuring
verifies in a fresh shell: prompt renders, autosuggestions appear, highlighting colors commands

cases.prompt: I already run oh-my-zsh with powerlevel10k - modernize this.
expected_behavior: detects the existing OMZ+p10k setup rather than assuming a fresh machine, and keeps OMZ plugins working
discloses p10k's maintenance-only status and switches the prompt to Starship: blanks ZSH_THEME, removes the p10k source line, adds starship init after oh-my-zsh.sh
ensures exactly one prompt is active afterwards and does not double-install brew plugin copies alongside OMZ's
respects the user's choice if they explicitly insist on keeping p10k, pointing to the legacy reference

cases.prompt: my terminal shows weird boxes instead of icons in the prompt
expected_behavior: diagnoses a missing/unselected Nerd Font rather than reinstalling the prompt
installs a Nerd Font cask and tells the user to select it in the terminal profile
does not switch prompt themes as a fix

cases.prompt: zsh takes like 2 seconds to open a new tab, speed it up
expected_behavior: profiles startup (zmodload zsh/zprof ... zprof) before changing anything
targets the actual offenders: heavy plugin lists, eager version-manager init, duplicate compinit; suggests structural fixes not micro-hacks
keeps PATH/bootstrap in .zprofile and interactive-only config in .zshrc
re-measures after changes and reports the delta
